import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:n+1]]
    
    # Kadane's Algorithm
    max_so_far = nums[0]
    current_max = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        current_max = max(x, current_max + x)
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, current_max)
    print(max_so_far)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()
